Hi Mina. Thank you for the support and the 5 star review!

Kelly at the front desk is an absolute nightmare with a terrible attitude. She blames clients for the clinic's own confusing rules and inaccurate website. This is our second time dealing with their poorly explained protocols.Thankfully, the clinic manager, Ruby, stepped in to clarify the rules and resolve the situation. Because one of our cats was a returning patient, they waived a fee and we got one cat seen.The clinic hides a major trap: afternoon appointments require an additional $35 wellness exam. They restrict certain vaccines to specific times of day, forcing you into this fee. Their website lets you book these vaccines anytime without warning you of the restriction.When I complained about Kelly to Ruby, Kelly whispered, made faces, and claimed the rule was online. When she checked the site, she realized she was wrong and defensively snapped, "I don't know what else I could have done." Being decent would be a start.To be petty at checkout, Kelly ignored us for 10 minutes while we tried to pay. The vet tech had already returned our cat and given aftercare instructions, but Kelly refused to process our payment because the tech hadn't clicked "complete" in the system yet. She is rude, inattentive, and has no business working in a care field.

Hi Felicia, thank you for the support and the 5 star review!

A consistent, high-quality, and compassionate resource for our community.

I have been going to this clinic for years and years with no issues whatsoever. While they are a limited-service clinic, the quality of care they provide is top-tier.

The staff is incredibly friendly and always provides honest, helpful feedback about my pets. One of the best features is their intuitive and organic scheduling system—you can easily book everything online, which is a huge plus.

As a low-cost clinic attached to the Arizona Animal Welfare League, you know your support is going toward a fantastic nonprofit organization. If you are looking for an affordable, reliable, and kind team for your pet's routine wellness needs, this is the place to go. They are proof that "low-cost" doesn't have to mean "low-quality"!

This clinic is insanely small and that would be my only gripe it does get chaotic in there due to the size. We came here for some puppy vaccines/microchip and they got us in fairly quickly; it was really busy since they are only open on Saturdays. They do take your dog/cat back and you aren't able to stay with them during the process, that doesn't bother me and I'm assuming it's  due to how small it is; however it's something to be aware of if that would bother you. The prices are the best in town and being open on Saturday was the main reason we chose this place. They are ran by relief vets and volunteers which is awesome that they do this for the community, Overall a great place.

1.12.2026 Updated:
I have had issues with trying to use the scheduling part of this website.  I have two cats to bring in for a wellness check and a set of vaccines each.  It looks like I can only do vaccines in the morning and then come back for a wellness check in the afternoon.  I have emailed the clinic because I'm unsure of their hours open for staff.  Now I have four separate appointments at different times on two separate Saturdays.  Help, please!!!

8.26.2021 UPDATE:  I'm still bringing my cats to this clinic.  Took one cat in yesterday and another in today.  Their clinic has a sign that states Masks are Required.  Big and right in the middle of the door.  Another client walked in with her dog, no leash or carrier, and no mask.  Everyone else had on a mask.  Everyone.  When I left, I mentioned this to the receptionist, asking her to please handle this.  I just had tested for Covid, negative twice, after coming in close contact with a non-masker, non vaccinated persons.  I think if there's a sign on the front door, the staff needs to do a better job of enforcing this.  The same client parked on the street blocking the sidewalk exit, too.  It was 109 degrees today, and I would of liked to park closer to the door, but I parked in the gravel parking lot.  I'm fine with that.  I've been bringing my pets here for years.  But with Covid, public health is a big factor with staying safe and healthy.  I just wish it was better enforced here.

The staff at AAWL Community Vet Clinic was incredibly attentive and helpful. I was fortunate to have one of the last appointments before lunch and had the chance to observe the manager and staff interaction. It was great to see the manager checking in on the front desk team and offering support before closing for lunch.

The front desk staff was knowledgeable and went above and beyond by helping me find another location for specialized bloodwork services. They also let me know I could add a nail trim for my pup, which was a thoughtful extra touch. The vet tech was kind and personable, making the experience even better.

You can tell the employees here genuinely care about their work, and that level of dedication translates to the care and attention given to both pets and owners. Highly recommend!
